Two files, 7 lines added and 4 deleted. The test edit is needed because the old test pinned the exact settings response.
No new error path is needed since the time zone is validated in config. The behind-UTC day boundary (AC2) has no test.
The summary and change list match the current handler and test, and the file list matches the checks record.
